# HsienYu Cheng (鄭先喻)

HsienYu Cheng (鄭先喻), Taiwanese artist and software developer: interactive installations, software art and bio-electronic devices about people, machines and code.

## Primary

- [Home](https://chenghsienyu.com/)
- [CV](https://chenghsienyu.com/cv/)
- [Contact](https://chenghsienyu.com/contact/) ([email](mailto:0x5a@chenghsienyu.com))
- [Full text](https://chenghsienyu.com/llms-full.txt)

## Awards

- 2014 Taipei Digital Art Award, First Prize
- 2017 Kaohsiung Art Award, New Media Art, First Prize
- 2019 Tung Chung Art Award
- 2021 19th Taishin Arts Award, Visual Art Award
- 2023 S+T+ARTS Nomination / Honorary Mention, Ars Electronica

## Recent Exhibitions

- 2023 Ars Electronica (Linz, Austria)
- 2025 Sónar+D (Barcelona, Spain)
- Solo and group exhibitions across Taiwan, the Netherlands, Slovenia, Norway, Italy, Germany, France, Austria, and Korea.

## 中文

鄭先喻，1984 年生於台灣高雄，藝術家兼軟體開發人員。
